request: How much have first-of-class Navy ships overrun their cost estimates?

reply.reply:
There is no supported fleet-wide overrun figure in the reports checked. For the first-of-class Ford, CVN-78, CRS reports a final procurement cost of $13,316.5 million in then-year dollars, but the evidence reviewed does not provide its original baseline estimate, so the overrun cannot be calculated (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 7). As a separate example, the Navy’s FY2026 budget estimated CVN-79 at $13,196.0 million and requested $150.0 million to cover cost growth; that is an estimate, not a final cost (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 2).

[See the brief for details](output/briefs/case-20261025-145340-ea2f.html).
reply.reasoning: Verified CRS evidence gives CVN-78 final cost and CVN-79’s FY2026 estimate/cost-growth funding, but not a baseline-to-final overrun calculation or a representative class-wide rate.
